title: The Package, the Classroom, and a Bowl of Hot Soup

sentences.chinese: 飞机降落的时候，大卫的手心全是汗。
sentences.english: When the plane touched down, David's palms were soaked with sweat.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 他今年三十一岁，是一个美国的高中英语老师。
sentences.english: He was thirty-one, an American high school English teacher.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 从今天开始，他要在中国的一所高中教书。
sentences.english: Starting today, he would be teaching at a high school in China.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 出了机场，天已经黑了。
sentences.english: By the time he left the airport, it was already dark.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 外面又热又吵，很多人在喊。
sentences.english: Outside it was hot and loud, with people shouting everywhere.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 他打开手机上的打车软件，叫了一辆车。
sentences.english: He opened the ride-hailing app on his phone and booked a car.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 十分钟以后，一辆白色的大众停在他前面。
sentences.english: Ten minutes later a white Volkswagen pulled up in front of him.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 是大卫吗？车牌号沪A五六七八。
sentences.english: Are you David? Plate number Hu A 5678.
sentences.speaker: driver

sentences.chinese: 是我，麻烦您了。
sentences.english: That's me. Thanks for your trouble.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 司机帮他把两个大箱子放进后备箱。
sentences.english: The driver helped him put two big suitcases in the trunk.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 你去哪儿？
sentences.english: Where are you headed?
sentences.speaker: driver

sentences.chinese: 去阳光路四十七号，是一个学校。
sentences.english: To 47 Yangguang Road — it's a school.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 阳光路啊，那有点远，走高速可以吗？
sentences.english: Yangguang Road, huh — that's a bit far. Is the highway okay?
sentences.speaker: driver

sentences.chinese: 可以，谢谢。
sentences.english: That's fine, thank you.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 车开上高速的时候，大卫看着窗外的灯。
sentences.english: As the car got on the highway, David watched the lights outside the window.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 每一个字他都认识，可是连在一起，他就看不懂了。
sentences.english: He knew every single character, but strung together they meant nothing to him.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 你中文说得不错啊。
sentences.english: Your Chinese is pretty good.
sentences.speaker: driver

sentences.chinese: 没有没有，我还在学，请多指教。
sentences.english: Not at all — I'm still learning. Please bear with me.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 你一个人来的？
sentences.english: You came on your own?
sentences.speaker: driver

sentences.chinese: 对，我一个人来的。
sentences.english: Yes, I came alone.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 司机笑了笑，没有再说话。
sentences.english: The driver smiled and said nothing more.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 四十分钟以后，车停在学校门口。
sentences.english: Forty minutes later the car stopped at the school gate.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 到了，一共九十八块。
sentences.english: Here we are — ninety-eight yuan altogether.
sentences.speaker: driver

sentences.chinese: 大卫扫码付了钱，拉着箱子走进那个陌生的校园。
sentences.english: David scanned the code to pay and wheeled his suitcases into the unfamiliar campus.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 他心里想：从今天开始，我的生活都是中文了。
sentences.english: He thought to himself: from today on, my whole life is in Chinese.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 第二天早上七点，大卫就醒了。
sentences.english: David woke at seven the next morning.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 他的房间很小，只有一张床、一个桌子和一个空空的柜子。
sentences.english: His room was tiny — just a bed, a desk, and an empty cabinet.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 八点，他去办公室找王老师。
sentences.english: At eight he went to the office to find Teacher Wang.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 你好，你就是新来的英语老师吧？我姓王。
sentences.english: Hello — you must be the new English teacher? My surname is Wang.
sentences.speaker: wang

sentences.chinese: 王老师好，我叫大卫。
sentences.english: Hello, Teacher Wang. My name is David.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 别紧张，我教你怎么用这里的系统。
sentences.english: Don't be nervous — I'll show you how our systems work.
sentences.speaker: wang

sentences.chinese: 这是你的课表，你这周有十二节课。
sentences.english: Here's your schedule — you have twelve classes this week.
sentences.speaker: wang

sentences.chinese: 请问办公室在几楼？
sentences.english: What floor is the office on?
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 三楼，你的座位在窗户旁边。
sentences.english: Third floor. Your desk is by the window.
sentences.speaker: wang

sentences.chinese: 第一节课是高二三班。
sentences.english: His first class was Grade 11, Class 3.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 教室里有四十五个学生，他们都看着他。
sentences.english: There were forty-five students in the room, all staring at him.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 同学们好，我们开始上课。
sentences.english: Good morning everyone — let's begin.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 没有人说话。
sentences.english: Nobody spoke.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 请把书翻到第二十页。
sentences.english: Please turn to page twenty.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 学生们翻书的声音像下雨一样。
sentences.english: The sound of pages turning was like rain.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 有没有人愿意回答这个问题？
sentences.english: Would anyone like to answer this question?
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 还是没有人举手。
sentences.english: Still no hands went up.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 大卫觉得自己站在一个很大的房间里，一个人说话。
sentences.english: David felt like he was standing in a huge room, talking to himself.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 下课以后，他问王老师：他们是不是不喜欢我？
sentences.english: After class he asked Teacher Wang: do they not like me?
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 不是，他们只是害羞，不太敢说话。
sentences.english: No — they're just shy and afraid to speak.
sentences.speaker: wang

sentences.chinese: 你给他们一点时间。
sentences.english: Give them a little time.
sentences.speaker: wang

sentences.chinese: 大卫点点头，可是心里还是很难受。
sentences.english: David nodded, but he still felt awful.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 中午他去食堂吃饭。
sentences.english: At noon he went to the cafeteria.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 他不知道那些菜叫什么名字，就指了两个看起来好吃的。
sentences.english: He didn't know the names of any dishes, so he pointed at two that looked good.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 那天晚上，他很早就睡了。
sentences.english: That night he went to bed early.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 十一月，天气一下子冷了。
sentences.english: In November the weather turned cold all at once.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 大卫的房间没有暖气，晚上冷得睡不着。
sentences.english: David's room had no heating, and at night it was too cold to sleep.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 你在淘宝上买一床厚被子吧，很便宜。
sentences.english: Buy a thick quilt on Taobao — it's cheap.
sentences.speaker: wang

sentences.chinese: 那天晚上，大卫第一次打开淘宝。
sentences.english: That evening David opened Taobao for the first time.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 屏幕上全是他不认识的词。
sentences.english: The screen was full of words he didn't know.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 满一百减二十，包邮，预售，秒杀。
sentences.english: Twenty off a hundred. Free shipping. Pre-order. Flash sale.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 这些字我都认识，可是我不知道是什么意思。
sentences.english: I know all these characters, but I have no idea what they mean.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 他找到一床被子，评分四点八，两万多人买过。
sentences.english: He found a quilt rated 4.8, bought by more than twenty thousand people.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 他看了一下买家评价，大家都说很暖和。
sentences.english: He read the buyer reviews — everyone said it was very warm.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 他点了加入购物车，然后点了立即购买。
sentences.english: He tapped Add to Cart, then tapped Buy Now.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 屏幕上跳出来一行字：请选择尺码和颜色。
sentences.english: A line popped up on the screen: please choose a size and color.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 他选了一米八的，灰色的。
sentences.english: He chose the 1.8-meter one, in gray.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 然后是：请确认收货地址。
sentences.english: Then: please confirm the delivery address.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 大卫把学校的地址复制进去，可是他不太确定对不对。
sentences.english: David pasted in the school's address, though he wasn't sure it was right.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 他也不知道自己的手机号有没有填错。
sentences.english: He also wasn't sure he'd typed his phone number correctly.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 最后他点了微信支付，输入了支付密码。
sentences.english: Finally he selected WeChat Pay and entered his payment password.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 订单成功了，页面上写着：预计三天后送达。
sentences.english: The order went through. The page said: estimated delivery in three days.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 三天，我只要再冷三个晚上。
sentences.english: Three days — I only have to freeze three more nights.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 他还顺便买了一个小电暖气和一双拖鞋。
sentences.english: While he was at it he also bought a small space heater and a pair of slippers.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 第二天，物流信息显示：卖家已发货。
sentences.english: The next day the tracking said: the seller has shipped it.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 第三天，显示：运输中。
sentences.english: On the third day it said: in transit.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 第四天，还是运输中。
sentences.english: On the fourth day, still in transit.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 第五天早上，他的手机响了。
sentences.english: On the fifth morning, his phone rang.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 是一个他不认识的号码。
sentences.english: It was a number he didn't recognize.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 大卫看着屏幕，心跳得很快。
sentences.english: David stared at the screen, his heart pounding.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 他接了电话。
sentences.english: He answered.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 喂，您好，我是顺丰快递的。
sentences.english: Hello, this is SF Express.
sentences.speaker: courier

sentences.chinese: 你好。
sentences.english: Hello.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 您有一个快递，现在方便签收吗？
sentences.english: You have a package — is now a good time to sign for it?
sentences.speaker: courier

sentences.chinese: 那个人说得很快，大卫只听懂了快递两个字。
sentences.english: The man spoke fast; the only word David caught was "package."
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 不好意思，我的中文不太好，能说慢一点吗？
sentences.english: Sorry, my Chinese isn't great — could you speak more slowly?
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 我说，您有一个快递！您在几栋几单元？
sentences.english: I said, you have a package! Which building, which unit?
sentences.speaker: courier

sentences.chinese: 对不起，我没听清楚。
sentences.english: Sorry, I didn't catch that.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 几栋！几单元！
sentences.english: Which building! Which unit!
sentences.speaker: courier

sentences.chinese: 大卫的脸红了。
sentences.english: David's face went red.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 他知道几是什么意思，可是栋和单元他从来没学过。
sentences.english: He knew what "which" meant, but he'd never learned "building" or "unit."
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 我住在学校里面。
sentences.english: I live inside the school.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 学校里面哪里？我到门口了，保安不让进。
sentences.english: Where inside the school? I'm at the gate and security won't let me in.
sentences.speaker: courier

sentences.chinese: 对不起，请再说一遍。
sentences.english: Sorry, could you say that again?
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 电话那边安静了两秒钟。
sentences.english: The line went quiet for two seconds.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 那我放到驿站，您自己去取，好吗？
sentences.english: I'll leave it at the pickup station and you can collect it yourself, okay?
sentences.speaker: courier

sentences.chinese: 大卫听懂了驿站和取。
sentences.english: David understood "pickup station" and "collect."
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 好的，谢谢您。
sentences.english: Okay, thank you.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 取件码我发到您手机上了。
sentences.english: I've sent the pickup code to your phone.
sentences.speaker: courier

sentences.chinese: 电话挂了。
sentences.english: The call ended.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 大卫坐在椅子上，看着自己的手。
sentences.english: David sat in his chair, looking at his hands.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 他教了九年英语，从来没有觉得自己这么笨。
sentences.english: He had taught English for nine years and had never felt so stupid.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 手机响了一下，来了一条短信。
sentences.english: His phone buzzed with a text message.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 上面写着：您的包裹已到阳光路驿站，取件码八四二七，请及时取件。
sentences.english: It read: your package has arrived at the Yangguang Road station, code 8427, please collect it promptly.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 他把这条短信读了五遍。
sentences.english: He read that message five times.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 星期六早上，大卫去找那个驿站。
sentences.english: On Saturday morning David went looking for the pickup station.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 驿站在学校后门旁边，是一个很小的店。
sentences.english: It was next to the school's back gate — a very small shop.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 里面全是货架，货架上全是包裹。
sentences.english: Inside it was all shelves, and the shelves were all packages.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 一个四十多岁的女人坐在门口，一边看手机一边吃早饭。
sentences.english: A woman in her forties sat by the door eating breakfast and scrolling her phone.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 你好，我来取快递。
sentences.english: Hello, I'm here to pick up a package.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 取件码？
sentences.english: Pickup code?
sentences.speaker: chen

sentences.chinese: 八四二七。
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 女人在电脑上打了几个字，然后摇摇头。
sentences.english: The woman typed a few characters into the computer, then shook her head.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 没有这个码。
sentences.english: That code doesn't exist.
sentences.speaker: chen

sentences.chinese: 有的，短信上有。
sentences.english: It does — it's in the text message.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 他把手机拿给她看。
sentences.english: He held out his phone for her to see.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 这是昨天的码，昨天的件已经被人取走了。
sentences.english: That's yesterday's code — yesterday's parcel was already collected.
sentences.speaker: chen

sentences.chinese: 被人取走了？
sentences.english: Someone took it?
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 对，系统上写着已签收。
sentences.english: Yes, the system says it was signed for.
sentences.speaker: chen

sentences.chinese: 大卫的心一下子沉下去。
sentences.english: David's heart sank.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 可是我没有取。
sentences.english: But I didn't pick it up.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 那我也没办法，你去找快递公司。
sentences.english: Then there's nothing I can do — go talk to the courier company.
sentences.speaker: chen

sentences.chinese: 后面排队的人越来越多。
sentences.english: The line behind him kept growing.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 有人小声说：这个外国人怎么这么慢。
sentences.english: Someone muttered: why is this foreigner taking so long?
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 大卫想说很多话，可是一句都说不出来。
sentences.english: David had a lot he wanted to say, and could not say any of it.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 他只会说我没有取，说了三遍。
sentences.english: All he could manage was "I didn't pick it up," three times over.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 好了好了，你先站到旁边，我先给他们弄。
sentences.english: All right, all right — step aside, let me deal with these people first.
sentences.speaker: chen

sentences.chinese: 大卫站到旁边，看着一个又一个人拿着包裹走出去。
sentences.english: David stood aside and watched person after person walk out with a parcel.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 外面开始下雨了。
sentences.english: Outside it began to rain.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 他没有带伞，就那样走回了学校。
sentences.english: He had no umbrella, and walked back to school just like that.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 星期一的第一节课，大卫的心情还是不好。
sentences.english: In Monday's first class, David was still in a bad mood.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 他站在讲台上，看见最后一排的小林低着头。
sentences.english: Standing at the front, he saw Xiao Lin in the back row with his head down.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 小林的手在桌子下面，一直在动。
sentences.english: Xiao Lin's hands were under the desk, moving constantly.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 小林，请你读一下这个句子。
sentences.english: Xiao Lin, please read this sentence out loud.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 小林抬起头，什么也没说。
sentences.english: Xiao Lin looked up and said nothing.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 你上课在玩手机吗？
sentences.english: Are you playing on your phone in class?
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 教室里一下子安静了。
sentences.english: The room went silent instantly.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 小林把手机放在桌子上，脸很红。
sentences.english: Xiao Lin put the phone on the desk, his face burning.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 把手机给我，下课来办公室拿。
sentences.english: Give me the phone — come get it from the office after class.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 大卫的声音比他想的大。
sentences.english: David's voice came out louder than he intended.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 小林站起来，把手机给了他，然后坐下，没有再抬头。
sentences.english: Xiao Lin stood, handed it over, sat down, and did not look up again.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 那节课剩下的三十分钟，没有一个学生说话。
sentences.english: For the remaining thirty minutes, not one student spoke.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 下课以后，小林没有来办公室。
sentences.english: After class, Xiao Lin did not come to the office.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 王老师走过来，坐在他旁边。
sentences.english: Teacher Wang came over and sat down beside him.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 我听说了。
sentences.english: I heard what happened.
sentences.speaker: wang

sentences.chinese: 他上课玩手机，我不能不管。
sentences.english: He was on his phone in class — I couldn't just ignore it.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 我知道。可是你看一下他的手机。
sentences.english: I know. But take a look at his phone.
sentences.speaker: wang

sentences.chinese: 大卫打开那个手机。
sentences.english: David unlocked the phone.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 屏幕上是一个翻译软件。
sentences.english: On the screen was a translation app.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 上面有一句话：老师说的paragraph是什么意思？
sentences.english: One line read: what does the "paragraph" the teacher said mean?
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 下面还有二十多句，全是他这几节课说过的英语。
sentences.english: Below it were twenty more entries — all English he had used in recent classes.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 大卫拿着那个手机，很久没有说话。
sentences.english: David held the phone and said nothing for a long time.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 小林的英语是全班最差的，可是他每节课都在查。
sentences.english: Xiao Lin's English is the weakest in the class, but he looks things up every single lesson.
sentences.speaker: wang

sentences.chinese: 他不敢问你，因为他觉得自己太笨了。
sentences.english: He doesn't dare ask you, because he thinks he's too stupid.
sentences.speaker: wang

sentences.chinese: 大卫想起了那个驿站，想起了自己说不出话的样子。
sentences.english: David thought of the pickup station, and of himself unable to get a word out.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 那天晚上又下雨了。
sentences.english: It rained again that night.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 大卫没有出去吃饭，他在美团上点了一份外卖。
sentences.english: David didn't go out to eat; he ordered delivery on Meituan.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 那家店评分四点八，起送价二十块，配送费五块。
sentences.english: The restaurant was rated 4.8, minimum order twenty yuan, delivery fee five.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 他点了一个套餐，还加了一份米饭。
sentences.english: He ordered a combo and added a portion of rice.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 备注上他写：不要辣，不要香菜。
sentences.english: In the notes he wrote: no chili, no cilantro.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 页面上写着：预计三十分钟送达。
sentences.english: The page said: estimated delivery in thirty minutes.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 三十分钟过去了，四十分钟过去了。
sentences.english: Thirty minutes passed. Then forty.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 一个小时以后，他的手机响了。
sentences.english: An hour later his phone rang.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 您好，我是美团外卖的，您的餐到了。
sentences.english: Hello, Meituan delivery — your food is here.
sentences.speaker: rider

sentences.chinese: 我在教师宿舍三号楼。
sentences.english: I'm in Building 3 of the teachers' dorm.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 我按门铃没人应。
sentences.english: I rang the bell and nobody answered.
sentences.speaker: rider

sentences.chinese: 请问您在哪个楼？
sentences.english: Which building are you at?
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 三号楼啊，门口写着三号楼。
sentences.english: Building 3 — it says Building 3 right on the door.
sentences.speaker: rider

sentences.chinese: 大卫拿着伞跑下去，门口一个人也没有。
sentences.english: David grabbed an umbrella and ran down; there was nobody at the door.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 他才发现，学校有两个三号楼：一个是宿舍，一个是教学楼。
sentences.english: Only then did he realize the school had two Building 3s: a dorm and a classroom block.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 不好意思，您是不是在教学楼那边？
sentences.english: Sorry — are you over by the classroom building?
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 对啊，我在教学楼门口。
sentences.english: Yeah, I'm at the classroom building entrance.
sentences.speaker: rider

sentences.chinese: 那个是教室，我住在后面的宿舍楼。
sentences.english: That's the classrooms — I live in the dorm behind it.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 电话那边的人叹了一口气。
sentences.english: The man on the other end sighed.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 我这边还有六个单，我给您放在前台了，您自己拿吧。
sentences.english: I've got six more orders — I'll leave it at the front desk, come get it yourself.
sentences.speaker: rider

sentences.chinese: 电话挂了。
sentences.english: The call ended.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 大卫跑到教学楼，饭已经凉了。
sentences.english: David ran to the classroom building; the food had already gone cold.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 他坐在楼梯上，把凉了的饭吃完。
sentences.english: He sat on the stairs and ate the cold meal to the last bite.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 雨打在窗户上，声音很大。
sentences.english: The rain hit the windows loudly.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 那是他来中国以后，最想回家的一个晚上。
sentences.english: It was the night he most wanted to go home since arriving in China.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 星期五下午，学校要开家长会。
sentences.english: Friday afternoon the school was holding parent meetings.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 小林的妈妈想跟你聊一聊。
sentences.english: Xiao Lin's mother would like to talk with you.
sentences.speaker: wang

sentences.chinese: 家长会在城东的一个校区，离学校有二十公里。
sentences.english: The meeting was at a campus on the east side, twenty kilometers away.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 大卫提前一个小时叫了车。
sentences.english: David booked a car an hour early.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 你去哪里？
sentences.english: Where are you going?
sentences.speaker: driver

sentences.chinese: 去东风路二十号，麻烦您。
sentences.english: 20 Dongfeng Road, please.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 东风路有两个二十号，你去哪个？
sentences.english: There are two number 20s on Dongfeng Road — which one?
sentences.speaker: driver

sentences.chinese: 我…我不知道。
sentences.english: I… I don't know.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 大卫把手机上的地址给他看。
sentences.english: David showed him the address on his phone.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 这个地址导航不到啊。
sentences.english: The map can't find this address.
sentences.speaker: driver

sentences.chinese: 车在路上开了很久。
sentences.english: The car drove for a long time.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 四点半，路上开始堵车。
sentences.english: At four thirty the traffic seized up.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 大概还要多久？
sentences.english: About how much longer?
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 说不好，这个点最堵。能不能走小路？
sentences.english: Hard to say — this is the worst hour. Shall we take the back streets?
sentences.speaker: driver

sentences.chinese: 可以，麻烦您。
sentences.english: Yes please, go ahead.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 五点十分，车停在一个门口。
sentences.english: At ten past five the car stopped at a gate.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 大卫下了车，才发现这里是一个医院。
sentences.english: David got out and only then realized it was a hospital.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 师傅，这不是学校。
sentences.english: Driver, this isn't the school.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 可是车已经开走了。
sentences.english: But the car had already driven off.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 他站在路边，雨又开始下了。
sentences.english: He stood at the roadside as the rain started again.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 他打开手机，给王老师发了一条微信：我坐错车了。
sentences.english: He opened his phone and sent Teacher Wang a message: I took the wrong car.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 五点四十，他终于走进那个教室。
sentences.english: At five forty he finally walked into the classroom.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 里面只剩下两个人：王老师，和一个很累的女人。
sentences.english: Only two people were left: Teacher Wang, and a very tired woman.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 你就是那个把我儿子手机拿走的老师吧。
sentences.english: So you're the teacher who took my son's phone.
sentences.speaker: lin_mom

sentences.chinese: 大卫站在门口，身上全是雨水。
sentences.english: David stood in the doorway, dripping wet.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 大卫坐下来，深深地吸了一口气。
sentences.english: David sat down and took a deep breath.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 对不起，我迟到了。
sentences.english: I'm sorry I'm late.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 也对不起，那天我不应该那样对小林说话。
sentences.english: And I'm sorry — I shouldn't have spoken to Xiao Lin that way.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 他说得很慢，每一个字都想了很久。
sentences.english: He spoke slowly, thinking hard about every word.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 他回家哭了。他从小学就怕英语。
sentences.english: He cried when he got home. He's been afraid of English since primary school.
sentences.speaker: lin_mom

sentences.chinese: 他爸爸在外地打工，一年回来两次。
sentences.english: His father works in another city and comes home twice a year.
sentences.speaker: lin_mom

sentences.chinese: 我不懂英语，帮不了他。
sentences.english: I don't know English. I can't help him.
sentences.speaker: lin_mom

sentences.chinese: 女人的声音很小，可是大卫全听懂了。
sentences.english: The woman's voice was quiet, but David understood every word.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 那天他不是在玩手机。
sentences.english: He wasn't playing on his phone that day.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 他在查我说的每一个单词。
sentences.english: He was looking up every word I said.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 女人抬起头，看着他。
sentences.english: The woman lifted her head and looked at him.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 真的吗？
sentences.english: Really?
sentences.speaker: lin_mom

sentences.chinese: 真的。他很努力，是我错了。
sentences.english: Really. He works very hard. I was wrong.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 王老师帮他翻译了几句他说不清楚的话。
sentences.english: Teacher Wang translated a few sentences he couldn't get out clearly.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 说到一半，大卫停下来，笑了。
sentences.english: Halfway through, David stopped and laughed.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 王老师，你现在做的事，就是小林那天做的事。
sentences.english: Teacher Wang, what you're doing right now is exactly what Xiao Lin was doing that day.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 王老师也笑了。
sentences.english: Teacher Wang laughed too.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 我在中国这三个月，很多话我也听不懂。
sentences.english: In my three months in China, there's a lot I can't understand either.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 电话我不敢接，快递我取不到，外卖我也拿错过。
sentences.english: I'm scared to answer the phone, I couldn't collect my parcel, I've picked up the wrong delivery.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 我知道那种感觉。
sentences.english: I know that feeling.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 女人看着他，很久没有说话。
sentences.english: The woman looked at him without speaking for a long moment.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 老师，那你以后…多说一点慢的英语，好吗？
sentences.english: Teacher — from now on, could you speak a little more slow English?
sentences.speaker: lin_mom

sentences.chinese: 好，我们一起慢一点。
sentences.english: Yes. Let's all slow down together.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 走出教室的时候，天已经黑了。
sentences.english: When they left the classroom it was already dark.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 我送你回去，我们坐地铁，比打车快。
sentences.english: I'll take you back — let's take the subway, it's faster than a taxi.
sentences.speaker: wang

sentences.chinese: 第二个星期一，大卫把手机还给了小林。
sentences.english: The following Monday, David gave Xiao Lin his phone back.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 小林，以后有听不懂的，你可以举手问我。
sentences.english: Xiao Lin, from now on, if you don't understand something, raise your hand and ask me.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 我的中文也不好，我们两个人一样。
sentences.english: My Chinese isn't good either. The two of us are the same.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 全班都笑了，这是三个月来第一次。
sentences.english: The whole class laughed — the first time in three months.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 老师，paragraph是什么意思？
sentences.english: Teacher, what does "paragraph" mean?
sentences.speaker: lin

sentences.chinese: 大卫在黑板上画了一个大大的方块，全班又笑了。
sentences.english: David drew a big rectangle on the board, and the class laughed again.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 从那天开始，小林每节课都举手。
sentences.english: From that day on, Xiao Lin raised his hand every lesson.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 有时候问单词，有时候帮大卫翻译一句中文。
sentences.english: Sometimes to ask about a word, sometimes to translate a Chinese sentence for David.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 十二月的一个下午，大卫又接到一个电话。
sentences.english: One afternoon in December, David got another phone call.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 喂，您好，我是顺丰快递的。您还记得我吗？
sentences.english: Hello, this is SF Express. Do you remember me?
sentences.speaker: courier

sentences.chinese: 是上次那个人。
sentences.english: It was the same man as before.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 您那个被子，上个月被别人取错了，我们找了很久。
sentences.english: Your quilt — someone collected it by mistake last month. We searched a long time.
sentences.speaker: courier

sentences.chinese: 今天找到了，我现在给您送上门。
sentences.english: We found it today. I'm bringing it to your door now.
sentences.speaker: courier

sentences.chinese: 太好了！我在教师宿舍三号楼，不是教学楼的三号楼。
sentences.english: Wonderful! I'm in Building 3 of the teachers' dorm, not the classroom Building 3.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 好，我知道了。
sentences.english: Got it.
sentences.speaker: courier

sentences.chinese: 二十分钟以后，一个穿蓝色衣服的男人拉着一个大箱子上来了。
sentences.english: Twenty minutes later a man in blue came up dragging a big box.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 我姓张，以后您的快递都是我送。
sentences.english: My surname is Zhang — from now on I'll be delivering all your packages.
sentences.speaker: zhang

sentences.chinese: 张师傅，麻烦您了。
sentences.english: Master Zhang, thank you for the trouble.
sentences.speaker: david

sentences.chinese: 您把楼号写清楚一点，我下次就不会跑错了。
sentences.english: Write your building number more clearly and I won't go to the wrong place next time.
sentences.speaker: zhang

sentences.chinese: 大卫拿出手机，请他帮忙把地址一个字一个字地改好。
sentences.english: David took out his phone and asked him to fix the address character by character.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 那天晚上，王老师叫他去家里吃饭。
sentences.english: That evening, Teacher Wang invited him over for dinner.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 桌子上有一大碗热汤，还有小林最喜欢的红烧肉。
sentences.english: On the table was a big bowl of hot soup, and Xiao Lin's favorite braised pork.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 小林和他妈妈也在。
sentences.english: Xiao Lin and his mother were there too.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 大卫，你尝尝这个，不辣的。
sentences.english: David, try this one — it isn't spicy.
sentences.speaker: wang

sentences.chinese: 大卫喝了一口汤，觉得整个人都暖了。
sentences.english: David took a sip of the soup and felt warm all the way through.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 他想起刚到中国的那个晚上，他一个人坐在车里，看着窗外的灯。
sentences.english: He thought of his first night in China, sitting alone in a car, watching the lights outside.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.chinese: 那些灯还是那些灯，可是现在，他知道下面住着谁了。
sentences.english: The lights were the same lights — but now he knew who lived beneath them.
sentences.speaker: narrator
